intro.text: Citylord Wistiow's head steward in Hearthstone.

items.text: Miliv disliked the town surgeon, Lirin, and Lirin's son Kaladin believed Miliv started many of the rumours about their family.
Miliv's wife was a nurse to Laral Wistiow. After Laral's father died, she kept Kaladin from visiting Laral, thinking town boys unsuitable friends for her.
Some time after Roshone arrived to replace Wistiow as citylord, Miliv died, and Natir became steward.
